workflow: Historical Claude-coordinated Codex CLI Astra image generation, windowsHide true, maximum 3 workers
style: STYLE: official Digimon franchise key art, in the look of the Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth / Hacker's Memory promotional illustrations and the Digimon Adventure anime key visuals. Clean 2D anime illustration: crisp, confident black line art with varied line weight; flat cel shading with one or two hard-edged shadow tones and small sharp highlights; bright, saturated, clean colors; strong graphic design with clear shapes and plenty of breathing room. The Digimon must be drawn on-model, matching the attached reference renders exactly in anatomy, proportions, markings and colors, translated from 3D into 2D anime line art. AVOID: painterly or oil-painting brushwork, photoreal or hyper-detailed AI rendering, orange-and-teal cinematic color grading, lens flares, heavy fog or volumetric god rays, dark or muddy lighting, generic fantasy castles, generic western dragons, made-up unnamed creatures, extra Digimon not requested, humans. No words, no letters, no readable text, no logos, no watermark; any code decoration is only abstract 0/1 digits and hex-like dashes.
notes: Nine new portraits generated using the recovered Claude-to-Astra Codex CLI coordination workflow. Faction Wars, Auto Chess and Chaos retain the previously approved Astra portraits unchanged. Arcane and Underlords received imagegen framing revisions. Source PNGs, labeled reference sheets, exact full prompts, worker logs and runner remain in the local task evidence directory .codex-safety/digitactics-carousel/art. Images are fan-game key art; no affiliation is implied.
